title: The introduced contact replied five days later; the reply is owed

objects.subject: Arjun <> Marco Ruiz (Altavia Partners)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Marco Ruiz, who backs B2B software at Altavia Partners. Marco, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Marco Ruiz (Altavia Partners)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Sorry for the slow reply. I'd like to understand how Nimbus handles investor pipelines. Could you send a short deck before we set up a call?

Marco Ruiz
Altavia Partners
